selection_rationale: Best alignment with CNSM Agentic AI Researcher track: focused, falsifiable security outcome (forbidden reachability), strong venue relevance, feasible within available emulation/verifier literature, and directly targets an important unresolved gap (verifier-in-loop effects on security-relevant misconfigurations).
unresolved_uncertainties: Verifier soundness and false-negative rate in practice (can the verifier miss security-relevant violations?).
Ecological validity of adversarial-intent generation (do synthetic perturbations match real malicious operator behavior?).
Risk that iterative repairs overconstrain configs and cause availability/regression issues not captured by security-only metrics.
Emulator and device-profile fidelity and vendor diversity (do results generalize beyond chosen testbed?).
Statistical power and sample-size adequacy for subgroup analyses (benign vs adversarial).
required_repairs_before_preregistration: Specify formal verifier semantics, known soundness/coverage limits, and provide at least one independent verifier implementation or an explicit oracle definition.
Define adversarial-intent generation methodology and threat model with concrete examples and justification for ecological validity.
Add availability/regression metrics (e.g., reachability loss, service-impact measures) and include them in primary or co-primary outcomes.
Prespecify device/vendor coverage, enumerate emulator choices, and include a sensitivity analysis over device profiles (or at minimum an emulation-compatibility matrix).
Detail a manual spot-check/audit protocol for verifier false negatives (sampling rules, annotator guidelines, adjudication).
